Documents · free, in your browser

A free Microsoft Word alternative in your browser

For letters, essays and simple reports, Documents gives you a page, styles and Word files in a browser tab, with no installation, no account and nothing uploaded.

Open Documents

How to do it

  1. Open Documents and start typing, or import a .docx you keep in Files.
  2. Format with fonts, sizes, paragraph styles, alignment and lists.
  3. Save to Files in this browser; drafts are saved as you type.
  4. Download Word (.docx), Markdown or plain text, or print.

Your files stay on this device: Documents runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Documents made by Microsoft?

No. ITpris Verktyg is not affiliated with Microsoft. Microsoft and Word are trademarks of their owner, named here only to describe what people search for.

Can it open my Word files?

Yes, from Files. Paragraphs, text formatting, styles, lists, tables and page setup are read. Pictures, headers, footers, footnotes, comments and tracked changes are not carried over yet.

Does it work offline?

Once the page has loaded, documents are edited and saved in the browser, so a lost connection does not stop you.

Is it really free?

Yes. There is no plan to buy and no account. Your documents stay on your device.
